contribution.position: On the reliability axis the change is not yet in a defensible state: peak-load run_time measured 118s against a 60s budget (nearly 2x over), and the service's own history shows two sev2 incidents last quarter caused by retry storms — exactly the failure mode an over-budget, slow-running report generator is most likely to aggravate under load. The green test suite (412 passed, 87% coverage) does not cover this gap, since unit-level correctness says nothing about behavior at peak load. Before the reliability question can be settled, we need evidence that the 118s peak run_time is either remediated or demonstrably non-interacting with the retry-storm failure mode, e.g. load tests with realistic concurrency and retry behavior, plus a stated error-budget impact analysis.
